name: BIG-bench: Beyond the Imitation Game Benchmark Suite
description: BIG-bench (Beyond the Imitation Game Benchmark) is a massive collaborative benchmark suite created by over 440 researchers across 132 institutions, organized by Google Research. Containing 204 distinct tasks, it probes large language model capabilities across reasoning, mathematics, biology, linguistics, common-sense, software development, translation, and social bias.
